notes.subject: ⟨Em⟩
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks overt subject; verbs imply Elohim-of-the-psalm as actor

notes.subject: salim bek
notes.rationale: פדות is ransom-deliverance, one noun; Tok Pisin needs the verb phrase salim bek

notes.subject: צוה לעולם בריתו
notes.rationale: rendered 'givim stia oltaim long kontrak'; verbless alternative: 'His covenant is commanded forever'

notes.subject: acrostic
notes.rationale: Psalm 111 is an alphabetical acrostic; this verse begins with פ, lost in Tok Pisin

translation: ⟨Em⟩ i salim ⟨את⟩ bek ol manmeri bilong en; ⟨em⟩ i givim stia long kontrak bilong em oltaim: Nem bilong em i holi na i mekem traus tru.
